id: \rFantina: Good practice, Drifloon. Return for now.
en: \rFantina: Good practice, Drifloon. Return for now.

id: \rHello there. Don't mind me, just doing some training.
en: \rHello there. Don't mind me, just doing some training.
it: \rSalve. Non badare a me, mi sto solo allenando.

id: \rOh, how rude of me. My name is Fantina, the Hearthome City Gym Leader. You wish to challenge me, no?
en: \rOh, how rude of me. My name is Fantina, the Hearthome City Gym Leader. You wish to challenge me, no?
it: \rOh, che maleducata. Mi chiamo Fannie, Capopalestra di Cuoripoli. Desideri sfidarmi, non è vero?

id: \rIt will have to wait till I return to the gym, but I will be back soon. Would you like a small taste of what is to come. I'm sure you will learn much.
en: \rIt will have to wait till I return to the gym, but I will be back soon. Would you like a small taste of what is to come. I'm sure you will learn much.
it: \rDovrai aspettare che torni in Palestra, ma tornerò presto. Ti andrebbe un piccolo assaggio di ciò che ti aspetta? Sono certa che imparerai molto.

id: \rFantina: What a wonderful performance. I look forward to our real battle.
en: \rFantina: What a wonderful performance. I look forward to our real battle.
it: \rFannie: Che splendida esibizione. Non vedo l'ora della nostra vera lotta.

id: \bI need to hide better. I'm so afraid.
en: \bI need to hide better. I'm so afraid.

id: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \bYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \bTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.
\rHo catturato i miei Pokémon insieme a Tia.

id: \bSo what if I don't have a Rock type. Don't label me.
en: \bSo what if I don't have a Rock type. Don't label me.
it: \bE allora se non ho un tipo Roccia? Non mettermi etichette.

id: \rI'm going to be a bit rough.
en: \rI'm going to be a bit rough.

id: \rGoing to Celestic Town. They have lovely ruins.
en: \rGoing to Celestic Town. They have lovely ruins.
it: \rVado a Memoride. Ci sono delle rovine bellissime.

id: \rThe routes ahead will be tough. Use it well.
en: \rThe routes ahead will be tough. Use it well.
it: \rI percorsi più avanti saranno duri. Usalo bene.

id: \rShow me just how powerful you are.
en: \rShow me just how powerful you are.

id: \rYou punch hard. I will never forget this.
en: \rYou punch hard. I will never forget this.

id: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \rAh, looks like a challenging trainer. Ready, Matt?
en: \rAh, looks like a challenging trainer. Ready, Matt?
it: \rAh, sembra un Allenatore tosto. Pronto, Matt?

id: \bAh, looks like a challenging Trainer. Ready, Jen?
en: \bAh, looks like a challenging Trainer. Ready, Jen?
it: \bAh, sembra un Allenatore tosto. Pronta, Jen?
\bNon smettere mai di librarti in volo.
\bNon posso credere che tu mi abbia visto.

id: \bAh, looks like a challenging trainer. Ready, Ava?
en: \bAh, looks like a challenging trainer. Ready, Ava?
it: \bAh, sembra un Allenatore tosto. Pronta, Ava?

id: \rAh, looks like a challenging Trainer. Ready, Zac?
en: \rAh, looks like a challenging Trainer. Ready, Zac?
it: \rAh, sembra un Allenatore tosto. Pronto, Zac?

id: \bPaul: So you came to see the ruins too? I bet the knowledge will be wasted on you.
en: \bPaul: So you came to see the ruins too? I bet the knowledge will be wasted on you.
it: \bPaul: Allora sei venuto anche tu a vedere le rovine? Scommetto che con te queste conoscenze andranno sprecate.

id: \bYou're on your way to beat the Hearthome Gym? I already got the Relic Badge. I suppose you'll never catch up.
en: \bYou're on your way to beat the Hearthome Gym? I already got the Relic Badge. I suppose you'll never catch up.
it: \bStai andando a battere la Palestra di Cuoripoli? Io la Medaglia Reliquia ce l'ho già. Credo che non mi raggiungerai mai.

id: \bPaul: Hmph. I suppose you tried your best, but you'll never achieve anything until you push your Pokémon's limits.
en: \bPaul: Hmph. I suppose you tried your best, but you'll never achieve anything until you push your Pokémon's limits.
it: \bPaul: Pff. Immagino che tu ci abbia messo tutto te stesso, ma non otterrai mai nulla finché non spingerai i tuoi Pokémon oltre i loro limiti.

id: \rHow dare you think I'm a boy.
en: \rHow dare you think I'm a boy.
it: \rCome osi pensare che io sia un maschio?

id: \bHehehe. My plan is flawless this time.
en: \bHehehe. My plan is flawless this time.
it: \bEhehehe. Stavolta il mio piano è perfetto.

id: \bHmm, I guess my calculations were off.
en: \bHmm, I guess my calculations were off.
it: \bMmm, a quanto pare i miei calcoli erano sbagliati.
